problem_text:
A factory must assemble 10 different electronic devices, each requiring a specific sequence of testing procedures.

Each device must pass through a series of 10 quality tests, represented as pairs (Test Station, Duration),
where each pair specifies the testing station where the procedure must be performed and the time it takes to complete.
The order of the pairs indicates the strict sequence in which the tests must be conducted.

Device details:
* D1 requires the sequence: (TS5, 5) → (TS10, 9) → (TS4, 2) → (TS1, 1) → (TS8, 4) → (TS7, 4) → (TS6, 6) → (TS3, 9) → (TS2, 3) → (TS9, 6)
* D2 requires the sequence: (TS6, 5) → (TS4, 7) → (TS5, 5) → (TS2, 2) → (TS10, 1) → (TS8, 1) → (TS1, 10) → (TS3, 3) → (TS7, 4) → (TS9, 9)
* D3 requires the sequence: (TS1, 8) → (TS9, 10) → (TS3, 5) → (TS5, 9) → (TS7, 4) → (TS8, 6) → (TS2, 2) → (TS10, 4) → (TS4, 4) → (TS6, 3)
* D4 requires the sequence: (TS3, 8) → (TS5, 8) → (TS8, 3) → (TS10, 9) → (TS4, 4) → (TS7, 7) → (TS2, 7) → (TS6, 5) → (TS1, 4) → (TS9, 6)
* D5 requires the sequence: (TS5, 5) → (TS8, 10) → (TS3, 9) → (TS6, 1) → (TS4, 8) → (TS7, 10) → (TS10, 1) → (TS2, 7) → (TS1, 10) → (TS9, 10)
* D6 requires the sequence: (TS3, 1) → (TS1, 5) → (TS9, 7) → (TS5, 2) → (TS10, 7) → (TS2, 7) → (TS8, 6) → (TS4, 4) → (TS7, 4) → (TS6, 3)
* D7 requires the sequence: (TS10, 8) → (TS8, 10) → (TS7, 2) → (TS3, 3) → (TS4, 5) → (TS5, 9) → (TS2, 4) → (TS9, 9) → (TS1, 6) → (TS6, 7)
* D8 requires the sequence: (TS10, 5) → (TS6, 3) → (TS2, 4) → (TS3, 3) → (TS4, 6) → (TS1, 6) → (TS5, 9) → (TS9, 4) → (TS7, 4) → (TS8, 10)
* D9 requires the sequence: (TS1, 4) → (TS9, 8) → (TS4, 9) → (TS5, 7) → (TS8, 5) → (TS3, 4) → (TS2, 2) → (TS6, 9) → (TS7, 8) → (TS10, 7)
* D10 requires the sequence: (TS10, 8) → (TS5, 3) → (TS6, 9) → (TS1, 8) → (TS7, 3) → (TS2, 1) → (TS9, 4) → (TS4, 3) → (TS8, 4) → (TS3, 10)

Each testing procedure must run continuously once initiated and cannot be paused, and each testing station can only handle one procedure at a time.
The objective is to schedule all testing procedures across the stations so that the total testing completion time for all devices is minimized.
